patch_list: Adds a MOD button that opens a cheat menu over the running game: god mode, infinite ammo, never wanted, one-hit kills, money, weapons, a vehicle spawner sorted by class, indestructible vehicle, nitro, time, weather, traffic and pedestrian…
The first time the game opens without the HD textures, offers to download them (965 MB, AI-upscaled 3D world and 2D art, from github.com/RAZORRZR0/ctw-packs). Interrupted downloads resume.
